integrity: A self-contained proof and two standard-library finite verification programs are supplied. Finite tests do not prove unbounded cases. Source-access restrictions and residual historical-priority uncertainty are disclosed. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact minimality is for complete deterministic Moore residue-output machines for scattered 0^a1^b; composite-modulus fixed-residue Boolean DFAs, other pattern shapes, and nondeterministic models are not classified.
title: Exact minimal modular subsequence counters for every binary two-run pattern
